name: Notice

subjectOf.text: The Model Act conditions the arrangement on notice to the market for shares by requiring a legend on the stock certificates that flags the agreement to purchasers of covered shares.
subjectOf.abstract: Finally, the Model Act language requires that a legend appear on the stock certificates flagging the agreement for purchasers who buy shares covered by such an agreement.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Shareholder Agreements - National Report of the United States of America (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3017612

subjectOf.text: Under the MBCA a purchaser of shares who bought without knowledge of an existing shareholder control agreement may obtain rescission of the purchase.
subjectOf.abstract: Under the MBCA, rescission may also be available to a purchaser of shares who did not have knowledge of the existence of a shareholder control agreement at the time of purchase.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Shareholder Agreements - National Report of the United States of America (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3017612
scope_conditions: purchaser lacked knowledge of the agreement at the time of purchase
